# Tb₂Ti₂O₇ on HEiDi

Fit the pyrochlore Tb₂Ti₂O₇ to constant-wavelength neutron single-crystal data from HEiDi at
MLZ, with anisotropic displacements and Becker-Coppens extinction.

The project is the catalogue case `sc-neut-cwl_tb2ti2o7-heidi`, the one the command line and the
app's Examples open.

<span style="color:#398648;background:#39864821;border-radius:3px;padding:0.1em 0.4em;font-size:0.85em"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="" style="height:0.85em;vertical-align:-0.1em;margin-right:0.3em">Fitting</span> <span style="color:#96601d;background:#96601d21;border-radius:3px;padding:0.1em 0.4em;font-size:0.85em"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="" style="height:0.85em;vertical-align:-0.1em;margin-right:0.3em">Single</span> <span style="color:#424242;background:#42424221;border-radius:3px;padding:0.1em 0.4em;font-size:0.85em">sc</span> <span style="color:#0084c7;background:#0084c721;border-radius:3px;padding:0.1em 0.4em;font-size:0.85em">neut</span> <span style="color:#424242;background:#42424221;border-radius:3px;padding:0.1em 0.4em;font-size:0.85em">cwl</span> <span style="color:#0084c7;background:#0084c721;border-radius:3px;padding:0.1em 0.4em;font-size:0.85em">Bragg</span> <span style="color:#00796b;background:#00796b21;border-radius:3px;padding:0.1em 0.4em;font-size:0.85em"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="" style="height:0.85em;vertical-align:-0.1em;margin-right:0.3em">Crystal structure</span>

```python
import easydiffraction as edi
```

## Load the project

```python
project_path = edi.download_data('sc-neut-cwl_tb2ti2o7-heidi', destination='data')
project = edi.Project.load(project_path)
structure = project.structures['tb2ti2o7']
experiment = project.experiments['heidi']
```

```text
Data 'sc-neut-cwl_tb2ti2o7-heidi' is at data/sc-neut-cwl_tb2ti2o7-heidi-38a48062af12/sc-neut-cwl_tb2ti2o7-heidi
```

The project marks what its fit frees. The fit below frees it in stages, so start with all of it
fixed.

```python
for parameter in project.free_parameters:
    parameter.free = False
```

```python
project.display.pattern('heidi')
```

## Perform the analysis

One new group per fit: the scale, O1's position, the displacement tensors, then the extinction.
diffraction-lib also fits occupancies and isotropic displacements, which this case keeps fixed.

### Scale

The scale brings the calculated intensities to the measured ones.

```python
experiment.linked_structures['tb2ti2o7'].scale.free = True
```

```python
project.display.parameters.free()
```


### Anisotropic displacements

```python
for tensor in structure.atom_site_aniso:
    for component in (
        tensor.adp_11,
        tensor.adp_22,
        tensor.adp_33,
        tensor.adp_12,
        tensor.adp_13,
        tensor.adp_23,
    ):
        component.free = not component.symmetry_constrained
```

```python
project.analysis.fit()
project.display.fit.results()
```

### Extinction

The domain radius and the mosaic spread.

```python
experiment.extinction.domain_radius.free = True
experiment.extinction.mosaic_spread.free = True
```

```python
project.analysis.fit()
project.display.fit.results()
```
